LESSON: MEALS AND SNACKS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.3: Meals and Snacks

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Meals and Snacks
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How many meals do we learner should be able to: the number of meals taken take in a day?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Meals and Snacks
2. give Kenyan examples of Meals and Snacks
3. practise a safe skill for Meals and Snacks

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Meals and Snacks

Teach
• Observe Meals and Snacks in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Meals and Snacks (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Meals and Snacks.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Meals and Snacks.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Meals and Snacks.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Meals and Snacks.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Meals and Snacks: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How many meals do we learner should be able to: the number of meals taken take in a day?
2. What is the difference in a day, between a meal and a snack?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Meals and Snacks with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
